integrationRule: No Perchance platform calls are permitted from the installed Android application or its independent backend.

ai-helper-blueprint-plugin.scope: Local adoption of protocol source, mode and overlay snapshot, SHA-256 verification, immutable audit and revision rollback; no remote instruction execution
ai-helper-blueprint-plugin.remaining: Exact behavior of the external Perchance plugin cannot be verified without that plugin’s original source

canceled-codebase-generator-plugin.scope: On-device editable HTML, sandboxed preview, local version history, import/export, collaboration and share
canceled-codebase-generator-plugin.remaining: Device-level runtime acceptance testing still required

canceled-ai-helper-thinking-plugin.scope: On-device trace journal and linked backstep records stored in SQLite
canceled-ai-helper-thinking-plugin.remaining: Device-level runtime acceptance testing still required

donation-link-2-ad.scope: User-configured HTTPS support links and wallet addresses with native clipboard actions
donation-link-2-ad.remaining: Device-level runtime acceptance testing still required

canceled-touchscreen-api-plugin.scope: Persistent button mapping and profiles, pointer/touch gestures, keyboard events and HTML5 Gamepad API virtual controller for owned local preview
canceled-touchscreen-api-plugin.remaining: Exact behavior of the external Perchance plugin cannot be verified without that plugin’s original source

server-plugin.scope: Android-owned persistent SQLite HTTP and WebSocket service, optional authenticated LAN hosting and outbound bridge relay, started and managed from the APK
server-plugin.remaining: Device-level runtime acceptance testing still required

ai-text-plugin.scope: Independent configurable OpenAI-compatible provider client and completion endpoints with no Perchance dependency
ai-text-plugin.remaining: Provider credentials, API availability and actual runtime/network testing required for production certification
